title: Yi Gong Chinese Restaurant
enTitle: Le Palais — Palais de Chine Hotel Taipei
summary: Retained the legendary 8 consecutive Michelin three stars in Taiwan from 2018 to 2025! An in-depth analysis of the space aesthetics of Le Palais, Taipei Grand Hotel’s Chinese restaurant, 7 famous dishes and a trilingual menu in Chinese, English and Japanese. It also includes a must-read dress code, vegetarian food and reservation guide for European, American and Japanese tourists.
quickFacts: 🥢 Top-notch classic Cantonese cuisine and handmade Hong Kong pastries

honors.heading: "Michelin Guide Taiwan" record of selections over the years: three stars, the highest honor for eight consecutive years
honors.content: Since the Michelin Guide debuted in Taiwan in 2018, Yi Palace has become the only dining hall in Taiwan to have been awarded the highest "three stars (excellent cuisine worthy of a special visit)" for eight consecutive years with its impeccable cooking techniques and exquisite tableside service.
honors.note: The original manuscript award record is as of 2025 and is not the current annual evaluation result.

sections.heading: When the French "palace" meets the literati gathering of the Song Dynasty, it recreates the ultimate elegance of the lost old Cantonese cuisine

children.text: The word "Yigong" comes from the Yi hexagram in the "Book of Changes" "Observe Yi and observe its nourishment", which means that food is not only the satisfaction of taste buds, but also a nourishment of body, mind and soul; and the French store name

Meaning "palace", it accurately echoes the design soul of Palais de Chine, which blends the architectural vocabulary of European castles with the aesthetics of the Eastern Song Dynasty. Since its opening with the hotel in 2010, the team has established the dual-axis positioning of "reviving lost old handmade Cantonese cuisine" and "extreme Hong Kong-style dim sum".

Based on the traditional Cantonese cuisine that emphasizes "fresh, fresh, tender, smooth, refreshing and fragrant", the Yi Palace culinary team carefully selects Taiwan's top local mountain and sea ingredients, and elevates the complicated and time-consuming ancient craftsmanship to the height of contemporary art. Whether it takes days to dry and roast, or the Cointreau orange liqueur blooms with blue flames at the table.
, or the famous soup dish made of old hen and Jinhua ham slow-cooked for eight hours. Every porcelain plate served on the table shows the irreplaceable depth and heritage of the top Chinese banquets.
The seemingly homemade barbecued pork and tofu milk are sublimated into works of art that astonished international food judges through the precise oil temperature and heat.

sections.content:
The word "Yigong" comes from the Yi hexagram in the "Book of Changes" "Observe Yi and observe its nourishment", which means that food is not only the satisfaction of taste buds, but also a nourishment of body, mind and soul; and the French store name Le Palais Meaning "palace", it accurately echoes the design soul of Palais de Chine, which blends the architectural vocabulary of European castles with the aesthetics of the Eastern Song Dynasty. Since its opening with the hotel in 2010, the team has established the dual-axis positioning of "reviving lost old handmade Cantonese cuisine" and "extreme Hong Kong-style dim sum". 
 Based on the traditional Cantonese cuisine that emphasizes "fresh, fresh, tender, smooth, refreshing and fragrant", the Yi Palace culinary team carefully selects Taiwan's top local mountain and sea ingredients, and elevates the complicated and time-consuming ancient craftsmanship to the height of contemporary art. Whether it takes days to dry and roast, or the Cointreau orange liqueur blooms with blue flames at the table."Flame Sliced Duck", or the famous soup dish made of old hen and Jinhua ham slow-cooked for eight hours. Every porcelain plate served on the table shows the irreplaceable depth and heritage of the top Chinese banquets. 
 The seemingly homemade barbecued pork and tofu milk are sublimated into works of art that astonished international food judges through the precise oil temperature and heat. 
—TAIWAN ROAM MICHELIN EDITION

sections.heading: Dining environment and atmosphere: a quiet night banquet intertwined with red brick arcades and candlelight

children.text: Stepping onto the 17th floor of the Grand Hotel, the dark walnut doors isolate you from the bustling hustle and bustle of Taipei Station. The interior uses simple red brick arches, Song Dynasty landscape painting imagery and precious antique embroidered screens to create a calm and private scholar's residence. Different from the hustle and bustle of ordinary Chinese restaurants, the atmosphere of Yi Palace
Extremely quiet, elegant and full of ritual

——The soft spotlight accurately falls on the center of the dining table, and the exclusive tea sommelier is on hand to brew Taiwan mountain oolong for the guests. It is the first choice for business banquets, important anniversaries and entertaining international distinguished guests.

sections.heading: Prophet Duck (reservation required 2 days in advance)

children.text: Carefully selected Yilan duck that is only 28 days old and weighs about one pound is stuffed with secret Chinese medicine and spices, marinated and air-dried before being grilled. The skin is as thin and crisp as glass, and the meat is tender and juicy. Eat two ducks together with pickled cabbage and duck soup, which is sweet and refreshing. It is a must-order dish for foodies visiting the Yi Palace.

sections.heading: Baked Boston Lobster in Soup

children.text: Carefully selected fresh Boston lobsters are oiled to lock in the chewy seafood flavor, and then simmered with old hen and Jinhua ham for eight hours in a rich soup to reduce the juice. The shrimp meat is sweet and plump, and the essence of the soup penetrates into the noodles. It fully demonstrates the heritage of top-notch Cantonese cuisine.

sections.heading: Fried tofu milk (a lost handmade Cantonese dessert)

children.text: A classic Cantonese dessert that tests the chef's oil temperature control! The golden crispy pastry is wrapped in warm and fragrant cheese, and sprinkled with fine powdered sugar. The salty and sweet mixture, rich and creamy but not greasy, is a stunning ending to the three-star banquet.
